name: "Dangerous" Devon Case
caption: The reigning L.A.W. Skyweight Champion, said to be departing for the UWF, who escaped a title defense against "The Cornerstone" Jeffrey Drake rather than risk the belt.

identity.note: Shares a common ring name with several other held wrestlers of unrelated promotions; no operator, roster or storyline axis ties this record to any of them.

name: Scotty Drake
notes: Known from four roleplays posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy from December 1998 to March 1999, served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/roleplay-judge-it-dammit-let-s-try-this-again-1998-12-08.html (8 December 1998), /promotions/rspwf/archive/scotty-drake-not-really-a-free-agent-1998-12-15.html (15 December 1998), /promotions/rspwf/archive/roleplay-critique-las-1999-01-30.html (30 January 1999) and /promotions/rspwf/archive/rp-2-critique-scotty-drake-1999-03-22.html (22 March 1999). A black-haired oil-rig worker from Atlanta who trained two years in the L.A.W. House of Wrestling, wears a "Traffik Jam" T-shirt, debuts against Boltz on 13 December 1998 and finishes with the Traffik Jam; by January 1999 he is the L.A.W. Pacific Coast Champion after a Jawbreaker on Steve Houston, and by March he is a boaster in the VAW. His handler's signature also lists the DSWA, the BFTW and "The Lethal Injection" Darren Scott.
caption: An L.A.W. rookie from an oil rig who is Pacific Coast Champion by January 1999, after a Jawbreaker on Steve Houston, and boasts for the VAW by March.

tenures.source: /promotions/rspwf/archive/roleplay-judge-it-dammit-let-s-try-this-again-1998-12-08.html (a debut roleplay posted 8 December 1998), /promotions/rspwf/archive/scotty-drake-not-really-a-free-agent-1998-12-15.html (15 December 1998) and /promotions/rspwf/archive/roleplay-critique-las-1999-01-30.html (30 January 1999)
